verdict.rationale: dLocal's own docs say it lets merchants accept local payment methods and currencies through one platform and settle funds globally, which covers the core local-charging and cross-border settlement idea. Nothing in the pack shows settlement into the merchant's own home currency or explains how FX is handled. missing for 10: explicit settlement-currency conversion to the merchant's bank currency, documented FX rates/fees/transparency, settlement timing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
